instructions:
1. Stand with feet together, holding a rope handle in each hand and the rope resting behind your heels.
2. Turn the rope over your head using your wrists.
3. As the rope passes under your feet, perform a small jump landing on the balls of your feet.
4. Add a second smaller bounce while the rope is overhead to set the rhythm.
5. Keep a steady double-bounce pace for the set duration. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep jumps low to reduce joint impact.
2. Turn the rope with your wrists, not your arms.
3. Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your core braced.
4. Wear supportive footwear.
name: Jump Rope double bounce

instructions:
1. Loop the rope over a stable bar at about chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
2. Step back to create tension and lean back slightly with arms extended.
3. Brace your core and keep your back straight.
4. Pull the rope toward your face, flaring your elbows out and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Extend your arms back to the start under control. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
2. Lead with your elbows high, not your hands.
3. Move under control without using momentum.
4. Make sure the bar can hold your bodyweight.
name: Jump Rope face pull

instructions:
1. Loop the rope over a stable bar at about hip height and hold a handle in each hand.
2. Step back to create tension and lean back with arms extended.
3. Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
4. Pull the rope toward your torso, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades.
5. Extend your arms back to the start under control. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull.
2. Keep your body straight from head to heels.
3. Move slowly and avoid jerking the rope.
4. Make sure the bar can hold your bodyweight.
name: Jump Rope row

instructions:
1. Stand in a split stance, one foot forward and one back, hands at your sides.
2. Lower into a lunge until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
3. Explode upward, jumping off the ground.
4. Switch leg positions in mid-air, landing softly in the opposite lunge.
5. Immediately lower and jump again, alternating legs. Repeat.
tips:
1. Land softly with bent knees to absorb impact.
2. Keep your front knee tracking over your toes, not past them.
3. Stay upright and keep your core braced.
4. Use your arms to drive the jump.
name: Jumping Lunge

instructions:
1. Stand on one leg with the other leg extended out in front of you.
2. Hold your arms out for balance and brace your core.
3. Lower into a single-leg squat until your thigh is roughly parallel to the floor.
4. Drive up explosively and jump off the ground.
5. Land softly on the same leg, absorbing the impact with a bent knee. Repeat.
tips:
1. Land softly and control the descent to protect your knee.
2. Keep your chest up and the non-working leg lifted.
3. Keep your core tight to maintain balance.
4. Master the standard pistol squat before adding the jump.
name: Jumping Pistol Squat
